collection.description: A survivor of past mistreatment becomes uneasy when a respected visitor repeatedly ignores personal boundaries.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager), a survivor of past mistreatment, becomes uneasy when (visitor), a respected visitor, repeatedly ignores personal boundaries.

choices.label: Avoid Assumptions About Who Can Be Harmed

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Hosts establish clear boundaries without demanding a disclosure.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (visitor) is asked to leave a private area.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They decline to explain their past and remain supported.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council states that anyone deserves bodily autonomy.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) corrects the belief that only one gender can experience coercion.

text_only.reason: "skill" in the everyday sense, not a skill gain -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (visitor)'s repeated boundary violations lead to exclusion.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (visitor) complies with clear rules and is monitored without declaring them innocent of every concern.
